events.title: Alte Bekannte — Mehr! Live Open Air Marburg
events.description: Germany's most successful a-cappella vocal ensemble, Alte Bekannte, performs at the Schlossparkbühne in Marburg as part of the Sommernächte series. With over 160 shows since their formation in 2021, the group has become a phenomenon with their unique blend of pop, rock, and classical crossover. Using only their voices — no instruments — they recreate complex arrangements of hits by artists from Queen to Ed Sheeran with astonishing precision. Their live shows are known for their humor, audience interaction, and jaw-dropping vocal virtuosity. The Schlossparkbühne's natural amphitheater setting with Marburg Castle illuminated above provides a magical backdrop. Tickets start at €34.65 and are available through the Marburger Sommernächte website.

events.title: Frankfurt City Night Run 2026
events.description: The Frankfurt City Night Run takes runners through illuminated streets of Frankfurt's city center along the Main River. The scenic 10km route passes landmarks including the Römer, Alte Oper, and Main Tower. Participants receive glow sticks and LED armbands creating a spectacular river of light. Music stations provide motivation at key points along the course. Registration includes a commemorative T-shirt and medal at the finish line. Entry fee is 25 Euro supporting local sports clubs.
events.location: Start at Römerberg, 60311 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Darmstadt Open Air Kino — Summer Cinema in the Park
events.description: Darmstadt's Open Air Kino returns to the Herrngarten park for summer cinema screenings under the stars throughout July and August. The program features a curated selection of international blockbusters, German films, and art-house cinema, with new films showing every few evenings. Screenings begin at dusk (approximately 21:30), with the park's century-old trees and historic buildings creating a magical atmosphere. Visitors are welcome to bring blankets, camping chairs, and picnic baskets, or purchase snacks and drinks from the on-site kiosk. The Herrngarten, Darmstadt's oldest public park, provides a central and easily accessible location near the Technical University. Tickets are €8-12 and are available at the box office or online, with reduced prices for students.

events.title: Weilburger Schlosskonzerte — Open Air Klassik im Schlosshof
events.description: The Weilburger Schlosskonzerte present a series of classical open-air concerts in the magnificent courtyard of Weilburg Castle, one of Hessen's finest Renaissance palaces. The program features world-class orchestras and soloists performing works from the classical repertoire, with the castle's historic walls providing exceptional natural acoustics. The concert series runs from mid-July through early August 2026, with performances on selected Thursday through Sunday evenings. Audiences are seated in the castle's inner courtyard, surrounded by centuries-old architecture and overlooking the Lahn Valley. Pre-concert guided tours of the castle's state rooms are offered, and the castle restaurant serves dinner before performances. Tickets range from €25 to €65 and are available through the Weilburger Schlosskonzerte website.

events.title: Bad Homburger Sommer — Dritte Woche Open Air Kultur
events.description: Week three of the 40th Bad Homburger Sommer continues with an exciting lineup of open-air concerts, theater, and cultural events in the beautiful Kurpark. The program includes a special silent disco night, open-air cinema screenings, and a children's theater performance. Events take place at multiple venues including the Kurpark, Kurhausgarten, and various squares throughout the spa town. Most events are free, with selected concerts carrying a modest admission fee of €5-25. The festival runs from July 10 through August 1, 2026, making it a central part of Bad Homburg's summer season. The Kurpark setting, with its historic buildings and manicured gardens, provides a beautiful backdrop for evening performances.
events.location: Kurpark & various venues, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Trebur Open Air 2026 — Indie & Rock Festival
events.description: The 34th Trebur Open Air brings indie, rock, and pop music to the charming town of Trebur in South Hessen from July 24-26, 2026. The festival features indie rock, punk, and electronic acts across multiple stages, with a lineup of 31-40 artists including national and international bands. Known for its non-commercial, community-driven ethos, the festival is organized by the Kulturverein Trebur and has been a staple of the Hessian festival scene since 1993. Three-day tickets include camping and access to the nearby Trebur lake for swimming, making it a complete weekend getaway. The relaxed, family-friendly atmosphere and affordable pricing (85€ for a 3-day pass) make it a favorite among festival connoisseurs. Food vendors serve regional specialties and international cuisine, and a dedicated kids' area ensures entertainment for younger visitors.

events.title: Love Family Park 2026 — 30 Years Anniversary
events.description: The Love Family Park festival celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2026, returning to the Rebstockpark in Frankfurt for two days of world-class electronic music. The lineup features international top DJs including Charlotte De Witte, Chris Liebing, and Sven Väth across three stages spanning house, techno, and open-air sounds. What makes this edition special is the three-decade milestone, bringing together veteran festival-goers and a new generation of electronic music fans. The festival runs Saturday July 25 and Sunday July 26, with gates opening at midday each day. Located at the Rebstockpark with Frankfurt's skyline as a backdrop, the festival offers camping options, food trucks, and art installations throughout the grounds. Tickets are available via the official website and Frankfurt Ticket, with day passes and weekend tickets available.
events.location: Rebstockpark Frankfurt, Rüsselsheimer Straße, 60326 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Offenbach Hafen Sommerfest
events.description: The Offenbach Hafen Sommer celebrates summer at the Offenbach harbor with live music and water activities. Bands and DJs perform on a floating stage in the harbor basin creating a unique atmosphere. Visitors can enjoy boat tours on the Main River and stand-up paddleboarding. Food trucks offer international cuisine from Greek and Vietnamese to classic German BBQ. A beach area with lounge furniture creates a vacation atmosphere right in the city. Free entry makes this an accessible summer destination.

events.title: Wetzlarer Rosenball Open Air Gala
events.description: The 73rd Wetzlarer Festspiele presents the Rosenball, a gala evening in the Rosengärtchen with dance music. A live big band plays swing, jazz, and dance classics under the stars. The rose garden creates a romantic setting for this elegant summer night. Guests are encouraged to dress in summer formal wear for dancing the night away. Champagne and cocktails are available at the garden bar. Tickets range from 25 to 48 Euro.

events.title: Bad Hersfelder Festspiele — Sommer Höhepunkt Programm
events.description: The Bad Hersfelder Festspiele continue their acclaimed summer season in the magnificent Stiftsruine with a special highlight performance. The open-air theatre in the atmospheric monastery ruins is one of Germany's most prestigious summer festival venues, drawing audiences from across the country. The 2026 summer program features a mix of classic dramas, contemporary plays, and musical productions performed by a talented ensemble of German actors. The illuminated ruins after dark create a magical backdrop that has made these performances famous since their founding in 1951. Pre-show dining options are available at restaurants near the venue, and guided tours of the ruins are offered before performances. Tickets range from €20 to €65 depending on seating category and production.

events.title: Kassel Kultursommer im Karlsaue Park
events.description: The Kassel Kultursommer continues with an open-air cultural festival in the beautiful Karlsaue Park. Live music from local bands spans rock, pop, jazz, and folk genres. Theatre performances and art installations are scattered throughout the park's gardens. A dedicated family area offers creative workshops and storytelling for children. Food stalls from local vereine serve regional specialties. Most events are free and open to all.

events.title: Frankfurt Comic & Cosplay Convention
events.description: The Frankfurt Comic & Cosplay Convention at Messe Frankfurt brings together comic fans and pop culture enthusiasts for a weekend of celebration. Artist Alley features over 100 comic artists selling original artwork and prints. The cosplay competition showcases incredible handmade costumes with multiple categories. Panels and workshops cover comic drawing, storytelling, and prop-making. The vendor hall offers comics, manga, figurines, and collectibles from major publishers. Day passes range from 15-25 Euros.
events.location: Messe Frankfurt, Ludwig-Erhard-Anlage 1, 60327 Frankfurt am Main

events.title: Neu-Isenburg Zeppelin Museum Summer Tour
events.description: The Zeppelin Museum in Neu-Isenburg offers special summer opening hours with guided tours of its airship history collection. The museum documents the history of Zeppelin aviation in the district that was once home to a Zeppelin airfield. Exhibits include original artifacts, models, photographs, and interactive displays. Guided tours explain the technical and historical significance of airship travel. The museum is located in the historic Zeppelinheim district. Entry is 5 Euro with reduced rates for children.

events.title: Bad Vilbel Open Air Cinema — Family Film Night
events.description: The Bad Vilbel Open Air cinema in the Kurpark presents a family-friendly film under the stars. The summer program features a curated selection of international blockbusters and German films. Screenings begin at dusk with the historic spa architecture creating a charming atmosphere. Bring blankets, cushions, and picnic supplies for maximum comfort. Snacks and drinks are available from the on-site concession stand. Tickets are 8-12 Euro available at the box office or online.

events.title: Dreieich Burgfestspiele — Sistergold A Cappella
events.description: The award-winning a cappella group Sistergold performs at the Burgfestspiele Dreieichenhain in the historic Burg Hayn castle garden. The five singers captivate with virtuosic vocals, humorous lyrics, and charismatic stage presence. The Burgfestspiele run from June 24 to August 9 with a multifaceted program. The historic open-air castle garden creates a special performance atmosphere. The program spans pop, jazz, and comedic elements appealing to all ages. Tickets start at 25 Euro available via Eventim.

events.title: Dietzenbach Kultursommer Open Air
events.description: The Dietzenbach Kultursommer brings live music and theatre to the Stadtpark for a summer evening of culture. Local bands present a diverse program spanning jazz, pop, rock, and world music. The relaxed park atmosphere encourages picnicking and socializing before performances. Food and refreshments are available from local providers and community organizations. The Kultursommer runs through August with weekend events. Free entry makes culture accessible to all residents.

events.title: Langen Sommerfest im Stadtpark
events.description: The Langen Sommerfest in the Stadtpark is the city's annual summer celebration with live music and family activities. Local bands perform rock, pop, jazz, and folk on the park stage throughout the day. Food stalls operated by local vereine offer grilled specialties and homemade cakes. Children's activities include face painting, bouncy castles, and craft stations. The festival creates a relaxed community atmosphere. Free entry makes it accessible for all ages.

events.title: Hofheim Stadtmuseum Photography Exhibition
events.description: The Stadtmuseum Hofheim presents 'Hinter dem Spiegel', an exhibition of award-winning contemporary photography. This Marta Hoepffner Prize exhibition showcases the best in German contemporary photography. Works explore themes of identity, perception, and photographic representation. The exhibition runs through August 30 with guided tours available. The Stadtmuseum is open Tuesday through Sunday. Admission is approximately 5 Euro.
events.location: Stadtmuseum Hofheim, Burgstraße 11, 65719 Hofheim am Taunus

events.title: Hanau Schlossgarten Open Air Concert
events.description: The Hanau Schlossgarten Open Air presents a summer concert in the beautiful grounds of Schloss Philippsruhe. Local and regional bands perform rock, pop, and soul against the backdrop of the illuminated castle. The park's ancient trees and manicured lawns provide a natural amphitheater. Visitors can bring picnic baskets and blankets for a comfortable evening. Food and drink stalls offer regional specialties and refreshing beverages. Tickets are 15-25 Euro with student discounts available.

events.title: Rodgau Bürgerpark Sommerfest
events.description: The Rodgau Sommerfest in the Bürgerpark is a family-friendly summer celebration with live bands and dance performances. Local musicians and cover bands perform rock, pop, and Schlager on the main stage. Food stalls offer grilled specialties, salads, and refreshing beverages with plenty of seating. Children enjoy pony rides, a petting zoo, and craft stations supervised by youth organizations. The relaxed, community-focused atmosphere attracts families from across the Offenbach district. Free entry with ample free parking.

events.title: Kelkheim Gutshof Rettershof — Brunch Concert
events.description: The Gutshof Rettershof in Kelkheim hosts a Sunday brunch concert with live acoustic music in the historic courtyard. Guests enjoy a curated brunch buffet featuring regional and seasonal specialties alongside live performances. The 16th-century estate provides a charming setting for this relaxed Sunday morning event. The concert features jazz and classical ensembles in an intimate setting. The brunch concert is part of the Kelkheimer Kultursommer program. Tickets including brunch are 39 Euro.

events.title: Friedberg Open Air — Roland Kaiser
events.description: German Schlager legend Roland Kaiser performs at the Friedberg Open Air on the Seewiese for a memorable summer evening. His timeless hits spanning four decades have made him one of Germany's most beloved entertainers. The Seewiese natural amphitheater with lake views creates a beautiful setting for the concert. This is part of a three-concert weekend at the Seewiese venue. Food and drink stalls serve regional specialties and refreshing beverages. Tickets start at 69.95 Euro with VIP packages available.

events.title: Darmstadt Jazz im Park — Summer Concert
events.description: Darmstadt's Jazz im Park returns to the Herrngarten for a Sunday afternoon of world-class jazz music. The program features established German jazz musicians and emerging talents spanning traditional jazz and contemporary styles. The park's century-old trees create a relaxed urban oasis perfect for afternoon music. Visitors are encouraged to bring picnic blankets and baskets to enjoy in comfort. The series runs through August with different ensembles each Sunday. Free admission makes this a beloved Darmstadt summer tradition.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Tunes and Tears
events.description: The Rheingau Musik Festival presents Tunes and Tears, an evening of emotionally charged music blending classical and contemporary works. The concert features acclaimed musicians in the intimate setting of the Kurhaus Wiesbaden. The carefully curated program explores the connection between melody and human emotion. Pre-concert talks offer deeper insight into the program and compositions. Tickets include a complimentary glass of sparkling wine during intermission. This concert is part of the festival's innovative programming.

events.title: Fulda Barockgarten Open Air — Classical Concert
events.description: The Fulda Barockgarten Open Air presents a classical concert in the magnificent gardens of Fulda's Stadtschloss. The symphony orchestra performs beloved classics by Mozart, Beethoven, and Strauss. Audiences sit on the lawn surrounded by meticulously manicured baroque hedges and fountains. The atmosphere is elegant yet relaxed, with champagne available during intermission. The historic palace provides a stunning architectural backdrop at sunset. Tickets range from 20 to 40 Euro.

events.title: documenta Halle Summer Exhibition Tour
events.description: The documenta Halle offers a special guided tour of its current contemporary art exhibition. Expert guides explain artistic concepts, techniques, and historical contexts of each work. The documenta Halle continues to host cutting-edge contemporary art year-round. The 90-minute tour is available in German and English languages. The building itself is a notable example of post-war German architecture. Museum entry is 8 Euro with the guided tour included.

events.title: Eschwege Altstadt Open Air
events.description: The Eschwege Altstadtfest transforms the historic old town into a vibrant festival zone with live music and food stalls. Local bands play rock, pop, and folk music on stages throughout the medieval streets. The festival showcases Eschwege's historic half-timbered architecture. Traditional Hessian specialties and local wines are available from vendors. A children's program includes games, face painting, and a mini train ride. Free entry makes this community celebration accessible to all.

events.title: Witzenhausen Kirschenfest — Cherry Festival
events.description: The Witzenhausen Kesperkirmes celebrates the cherry capital of Hessen with its annual cherry festival. Local fruit growers present fresh cherries, jams, juices, and cherry liqueur. The German championship in cherry pit spitting draws numerous spectators. Live music, dance performances, and a fun fair create a festive atmosphere. Guided walks through surrounding cherry orchards explain local traditions. Free entry to the old town festival grounds.

events.title: Tom Odell — Open Air im Kurpark Wiesbaden
events.description: British singer-songwriter Tom Odell brings his intimate and emotionally charged live performance to the Hessenbühne in Wiesbaden's Kurpark as part of the Rheingau Musik Festival. Known for his heartfelt piano-driven songs including 'Another Love', 'Heal', and 'Magnetised', Odell's concerts are deeply moving experiences that connect directly with the audience. The open-air stage in the Kurpark, surrounded by historic spa architecture and manicured gardens, provides a stunning natural amphitheater. This concert is part of the Rheingau Musik Festival's 2026 program, which features 158 concerts at 26 venues across the region. Gates open approximately 90 minutes before the performance, and the grounds offer food and drink vendors. Tickets are available through the Rheingau Musik Festival website and include access to the beautiful Kurpark grounds.

events.title: Settimana Italiana at Hauptwache
events.description: Italian Week transforms Frankfurt's Hauptwache into an Italian piazza for ten days of food, culture, and entertainment. Stalls offer authentic Italian cuisine from pizza to gelato prepared by Italian chefs. Cooking demonstrations showcase regional specialties from across Italy. Live music features Italian classics from opera to modern pop. A children's area offers pizza-making workshops. Free entry makes this a delightful taste of Italy in Frankfurt's heart.

events.title: Freiluftkino Frankfurt — Open Air Cinema Late July
events.description: The Freiluftkino Frankfurt continues its summer cinema season on the banks of the Main River. Guests watch blockbuster films and classics on a large outdoor screen under the stars. The setting with Frankfurt's illuminated skyline creates a magical summer evening experience. Snacks, popcorn, and cold drinks are available at the venue. New films are shown every few evenings throughout the summer. Tickets are 12 Euro with reduced rates available.

events.title: Klingspor Museum Typography Workshop
events.description: The Klingspor Museum in Offenbach offers a special summer workshop on the art of typography and book design. Participants learn about the history of printing from Gutenberg to modern digital techniques. Hands-on sessions allow visitors to try letterpress printing on historic presses. The museum's collection of modern book art and calligraphy provides inspiration. The workshop is suitable for beginners and experienced designers. All materials are included in the ticket price of 15 Euro.
events.location: Klingspor Museum, Herrnstraße 80, 63065 Offenbach am Main

events.title: Herzberg Festival 2026 — Europas ältestes Hippie-Festival
events.description: The Herzberg Festival at Burg Herzberg in Breitenbach is Europe's oldest and quirkiest hippie festival, celebrating its annual gathering from July 30 to August 2, 2026. The lineup features international rock, reggae, and world music acts with confirmed artists including Kadavar, Walter Trout, Wolfmother, and Hilight Tribe. The festival takes place on the grounds of the historic Burg Herzberg, a medieval castle offering panoramic views of the Hessian countryside. Beyond music, the festival offers a colorful market with handmade crafts, yoga sessions, a children's program, and a legendary spontaneous jam culture. Camping is included with multi-day tickets, and the festival is known for its peaceful, family-friendly, and inclusive atmosphere. Tickets range from approximately €195 for the full weekend including camping, with day tickets also available.

events.title: Mainfest Frankfurt — Traditional Riverside Festival
events.description: The Mainfest is one of Frankfurt's oldest and most beloved traditional festivals, dating back to 1340 when it began as a fishermen's celebration. Held along the Mainkai, Römerberg, and Fahrtor, the festival transforms the historic riverside into a vibrant fairground with rides, games, and live music. Visitors can enjoy traditional Frankfurt specialties including Grüne Soße, Frankfurter Würstchen, and Handkäse mit Musik at numerous food stalls. The festival runs from July 31 to August 3, 2026, featuring a colorful mix of amusement rides, a large flea market, and live bands on multiple stages. The highlight is the spectacular fireworks display over the Main River on Saturday evening, lighting up Frankfurt's iconic skyline. Entry is free, making this one of the most accessible and authentic Frankfurt summer experiences for all ages.

events.title: Orscheler Sommer — Live Music Night Oberursel
events.description: The 40th Orscheler Sommer features a special live music night in Rushmoorpark Oberursel. Local bands perform a mix of rock, pop, folk, and jazz genres. Visitors bring blankets and picnic baskets for a relaxed evening under the stars. The Orscheler Sommer runs through September with approximately 40 free events. This community festival has been a beloved Oberursel tradition for four decades. Free entry makes this one of the best-value summer events in the Taunus region.

events.title: Bad Homburg Silent Disco Night
events.description: The Bad Homburger Sommer features a Silent Disco Night in the Kurpark with three DJs on different channels. Dancers switch between musical genres by changing channels on wireless headphones. The illuminated Kurpark with historic buildings creates a magical nighttime setting. Headphones are provided free of charge at the entrance. The silent concept allows the party to continue without noise restrictions. Free entry makes this an accessible and unique nightlife experience.
events.location: Kurpark Bad Homburg, 61348 Bad Homburg vor der Höhe

events.title: Weilburger Schlosskonzerte — Klassik Open Air II
events.description: The second series of Weilburger Schlosskonzerte in the castle courtyard presents a program of orchestral masterpieces performed by a renowned German symphony orchestra. The program features works by Beethoven, Brahms, and Dvořák, conducted by a guest conductor of international standing. The castle courtyard's natural amphitheater and the warm summer evening create an unforgettable concert experience, with the illuminated castle walls providing a magical backdrop. Wine and champagne are available during intermission at the castle's own wine cellar. Seating is reserved, with premium categories offering the best views of both the orchestra and the castle architecture. Tickets are available online, with early booking recommended as these concerts consistently sell out weeks in advance.

events.title: Kassel Nachtflohmarkt am Friedrichsplatz
events.description: The Kassel Nachtflohmarkt transforms Friedrichsplatz into a magical night-time treasure hunt under string lights. Vendors sell vintage clothing, antiques, vinyl records, books, and collectibles. Live DJs create a festive atmosphere for evening browsing. Food trucks and cocktail bars provide refreshments throughout the night. The Fridericianum museum provides a stunning illuminated backdrop. Free entry makes this a popular summer evening destination.

events.title: Gießen Stadtpark Open Air Festival
events.description: The Gießen Stadtpark transforms into a vibrant festival location with live music and family activities. Bands from across Hessen perform rock, pop, indie, and electronic genres on the main stage. Food stalls operated by local vereine offer regional specialties and international cuisine. A children's area features bouncy castles, face painting, and craft stations. The relaxed park atmosphere attracts families and students from across Mittelhessen. Free entry makes this a popular summer event.

events.title: Königstein Burg Open Air — Klassik Konzert
events.description: A classical open-air concert in the courtyard of Burg Königstein, one of Germany's largest castle ruins. Regional orchestras perform works by Mozart, Beethoven, and Brahms with the castle walls providing spectacular natural acoustics. Audiences are seated in the historic courtyard overlooking the Taunus landscape. Pre-concert guided tours of the castle explain its 500-year history. The castle cafe is open before the concert and during intermission. Tickets are 20-35 Euro available through the Königstein tourist office.

events.title: Butzbach Historische Altstadtführung
events.description: A guided historical walking tour through Butzbach's beautifully preserved medieval old town. The tour covers the landmark Haus zum Löwen, the historic Marktplatz, and the town's Roman and medieval history. Costumed guides bring history to life with stories from Butzbach's past. The 2-hour tour covers approximately 2km of mostly flat, walkable paths. Tours are available in German with English summaries available on request. Cost is 10 Euro per person with children under 12 free.

events.title: Bad Nauheim Sommerreihe Jazz Night
events.description: The Bad Nauheim Sommerreihe presents a special jazz night at the historic Trinkkuranlage. A renowned guest artist performs smooth jazz, bossa nova, and contemporary standards. The Art Nouveau architecture and park setting provide an elegant concert backdrop. Audiences are encouraged to arrive early for good lawn spots and sunset views. Food and regional wine are available for purchase during the concert. Tickets start at 27 Euro from the Bad Nauheim cultural office.

events.title: Frankfurter Apfelweinfest — Cider Festival on Roßmarkt
events.description: The Frankfurter Apfelweinfest transforms the Roßmarkt in central Frankfurt into a celebration of Hessen's iconic apple wine culture from August 7-16, 2026. Local cider houses (Apfelweinwirtschaften) present their finest Ebbelwei, from traditional sour varieties to modern fruit-infused creations. Visitors can sample different Apfelwein styles served in the traditional blue-and-white checked Bembel pitchers, accompanied by hearty Hessian cuisine. Live music performances from brass bands, jazz ensembles, and contemporary artists create a festive atmosphere throughout the ten-day event. The festival showcases Frankfurt's culinary heritage with dishes like Handkäse mit Musik, Frankfurter Rippchen mit Kraut, and Grüne Soße. Free entry to the Roßmarkt makes this an accessible celebration of authentic Frankfurt food and drink culture.

events.title: Eschborn Kultursommer — Open Air World Music
events.description: Eschborn's Kultursommer presents a world music open air at the historic Museumshof. Artists perform traditional and contemporary music from Africa, Latin America, Asia, and Europe. The half-timbered courtyard provides a charming setting for the international program. International food stalls complement the musical journey around the globe. Free entry makes this accessible to all residents of Eschborn. The concert is weather-dependent with a rain alternative location.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Crown and Glory — VOCES8
events.description: The acclaimed vocal ensemble VOCES8 performs Crown and Glory at the Rheingau Musik Festival. The program features a cappella masterworks from the Renaissance to contemporary compositions. The Friedrich-von-Thiersch-Saal provides exceptional acoustics for this evening of vocal virtuosity. A pre-concert talk offers insights into the program and artistic journey. Tickets range from 28 to 48 Euro. The Rheingau Musik Festival runs through September 5.

events.title: Darmstadt Science Summer — Family Discovery Day
events.description: The Darmstadt Science Summer offers a family-friendly day of hands-on science experiments at the Wissenschaftsstadt. Interactive exhibits range from chemistry and physics to robotics and space exploration. The TU Darmstadt presents its latest research projects in accessible ways for all ages. Highlights include a planetarium show, robotics workshop, and live science demonstrations. The event encourages young people to explore careers in science and technology. Entry is free with some workshops requiring advance registration.

events.title: Rheingau Musik Festival: Jazz Night mit Hayato Sumino
events.description: Japanese piano sensation Hayato Sumino, the Artist in Residence of the 2026 Rheingau Musik Festival, presents a special jazz concert blending classical, jazz, and his own compositions. Sumino is renowned for his extraordinary versatility, moving seamlessly between classical piano repertoire, jazz improvisation, and contemporary compositions. The concert takes place at the Kurhaus Wiesbaden's Friedrich-von-Thiersch-Saal, celebrated for its exceptional acoustics and elegant Art Nouveau architecture. As Artist in Residence, Sumino performs seven concerts throughout the festival, showcasing his complete musical range. The Rheingau Musik Festival runs from June 20 to September 5, 2026, with 158 concerts at 26 venues. Tickets range from €28 to €58 and include a complimentary glass of sparkling wine during intermission.

events.title: Kultur.findet.Stadt — Open Air Festival im Museumshof Fulda
events.description: Kultur.findet.Stadt transforms the historic Museumshof in Fulda into a premier open-air festival venue from August 13-30, 2026. The program features an eclectic mix of artists including Dick Brave, Gentleman, ClockClock, Betterov, and Mittelalter-Rock and Heavy Metal acts. The Museumshof, set within Fulda's baroque old town, provides an intimate courtyard setting with exceptional acoustics and a charming historic atmosphere. Each evening features a different headliner, allowing visitors to choose from genres spanning pop, reggae, rock, and indie music. Food and drink stalls offer regional specialties and festival classics, with the historic surroundings creating a unique concert-going experience. Tickets range from €25 to €55 per concert and are available through Eventim and the Fulda tourist information office.
events.location: Museumshof Fulda, Unterm Heilig Kreuz, 36037 Fulda

events.title: Wiesbaden Wine Tasting Evening
events.description: Experience finest Rheingau wines at a wine tasting event in Wiesbaden's historic city center. Local vintners present their award-winning Rieslings and Spätburgunders for tasting. Sommeliers guide visitors through flavor profiles and explain the Rheingau terroir. Regional cheese and charcuterie boards accompany the wines for a complete culinary experience. Live acoustic jazz provides a sophisticated backdrop to the evening. Tickets are 35 Euro per person including tastings and food pairings.

events.title: Museumsuferfest Frankfurt — Europas größtes Kulturfestival
events.description: The Museumsuferfest is one of Europe's largest cultural festivals, transforming both banks of the Main River in Frankfurt into a three-day celebration of art, music, and culture. Over 25 museums along the Museumsufer open their doors with special exhibitions, guided tours, and hands-on activities for visitors of all ages. More than 12 stages feature live music spanning classical, jazz, rock, pop, and world music, while over 400 food and craft stalls line the riverbanks. The festival runs from August 28-30, 2026, with the iconic Frankfurt skyline and illuminated museums creating a spectacular nighttime atmosphere. Highlights include the Nizza stage with jazz and soul, the museum courtyards with experimental performances, and the spectacular fireworks display on Saturday. Most museum entries are free during the festival, and the open-air concerts along the Main are free to attend.
events.cost_per_person: Free entry (museum entries free during fest)
events.location: Museumsufer (both sides of Main), 60594 Frankfurt am Main
